review_kind: read-only source review; no test or native execution
decision: Acceptable as the minimal bounded retention change to evaluate under the unchanged original resource limits and 300-second gate; no qualification implied.
correctness_findings: The complete current str remains the cache key, after safe(root,path) and the real read_text on every check. No path, mtime, size, or validation verdict is cached.

Both eligible ranges invoke exactly the same pure parser. The changed threshold only retains more completed results. Rust returns immutable str, Python returns frozenset[str], and parser exceptions remain uncached.
Same-path, same-size, same-mtime content edits still select a different full-content key. Comment/string masking and attributed-test checks remain unchanged.
Each parser retains at most 128 entries; oversize text still takes the complete original parser. The change does not truncate or skip source.
No caller, checker, original test, workflow, CPU/RAM setting, timeout or acceptance count is changed by this patch.
resource_findings: There are two independent 128-entry LRU caches, not one shared 128-entry cache.
The threshold is Python character count, not a byte/RSS limit. It doubles the maximum retained input size per entry; Unicode string representation and Python symbol/frozenset overhead matter.

For worst-case full caches at 524288 chars, ASCII input keys for both caches plus Rust output strings alone could occupy about 192 MiB; a four-byte-per-character representation could occupy about 768 MiB, excluding Python summaries and object overhead. These are conservative capacity calculations, not observed memory use.

For the same actual source inputs, cold parser working memory is unchanged: the previously oversize files were already fully parsed. The added cost is retention between calls, with possible LRU eviction/churn.

Real read_text, content hashing/equality, rust_impl_bodies/rust_direct_method scans, regular expressions, registry relationships and all remaining validation still run. A mask-cache hit does not prove that the whole suite fits 300 seconds.

observations_supplied_by_root.observation_scope: Parent and W1 reported these values; this review has not independently read the full C3 execution raw or measured RSS.

remaining_required_evidence: Actual complete C4 checkout with original source/dependency guards, unchanged original controls and original 300-second/resource gates. Preserve C2/C3 timeouts. No optional heavy tests requested.
